verses.original: צֹפַ֥ר הַנַּֽעֲמָתִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃ וַ֭יַּעַן
verses.transliteration: ṣō·p̄ar han·na·‘ă·mā·ṯî way·yō·mar way·ya·‘an
verses.literal: Then Zophar the Naamathite . . . replied

verses.original: לָ֭כֵן שְׂעִפַּ֣י יְשִׁיב֑וּנִי וּ֝בַעֲב֗וּר ח֣וּשִׁי בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên śə·‘ip·pay yə·šî·ḇū·nî ū·ḇa·‘ă·ḇūr ḥū·šî ḇî
verses.literal: So my anxious thoughts compel me to answer because of the turmoil within me

verses.original: אֶשְׁמָ֑ע וְ֝ר֗וּחַ מוּסַ֣ר כְּלִמָּתִ֣י מִֽבִּינָתִ֥י יַעֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’eš·mā‘ wə·rū·aḥ mū·sar kə·lim·mā·ṯî mib·bî·nā·ṯî ya·‘ă·nê·nî
verses.literal: I have heard . . . a rebuke that insults me and my understanding prompts a reply

verses.original: יָ֭דַעְתָּ הֲזֹ֣את מִנִּי־ עַ֑ד מִנִּ֤י אָדָ֣ם שִׂ֖ים עֲלֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḏa‘·tā hă·zōṯ min·nî- ‘aḏ min·nî ’ā·ḏām śîm ‘ă·lê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Do you not know that from antiquity since man was placed on the earth

verses.original: כִּ֤י רִנְנַ֣ת רְ֭שָׁעִים מִקָּר֑וֹב וְשִׂמְחַ֖ת חָנֵ֣ף עֲדֵי־ רָֽגַע׃
verses.transliteration: kî rin·naṯ rə·šā·‘îm miq·qā·rō·wḇ wə·śim·ḥaṯ ḥā·nêp̄ ‘ă·ḏê- rā·ḡa‘
verses.literal: - the triumph of the wicked has been brief and the joy of the godless vvv momentary

verses.original: אִם־ שִׂיא֑וֹ יַעֲלֶ֣ה לַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְ֝רֹאשׁ֗וֹ יַגִּֽיעַ׃ לָעָ֥ב
verses.transliteration: ’im- śî·’ōw ya·‘ă·leh laš·šā·ma·yim wə·rō·šōw yag·gî·a‘ lā·‘āḇ
verses.literal: Though his arrogance reaches the heavens and his head touches the clouds

verses.original: יֹאבֵ֑ד לָנֶ֣צַח כְּֽ֭גֶלֲלוֹ רֹ֝אָ֗יו יֹאמְר֥וּ אַיּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yō·ḇêḏ lā·ne·ṣaḥ kə·ḡe·lă·lōw rō·’āw yō·mə·rū ’ay·yōw
verses.literal: he will perish forever like his own dung those who had seen him will ask Where is he

verses.original: יָ֭עוּף כַּחֲל֣וֹם וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָא֑וּהוּ וְ֝יֻדַּ֗ד כְּחֶזְי֥וֹן לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: yā·‘ūp̄ ka·ḥă·lō·wm wə·lō yim·ṣā·’ū·hū wə·yud·daḏ kə·ḥez·yō·wn lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: He will fly away like a dream never to be found he will be chased away like a vision in the night

verses.original: עַ֣יִן שְׁ֭זָפַתּוּ וְלֹ֣א תוֹסִ֑יף מְקוֹמֽוֹ׃ וְלֹא־ ע֝֗וֹד תְּשׁוּרֶ֥נּוּ
verses.transliteration: ‘a·yin šə·zā·p̲at·tû wə·lō ṯō·w·sîp̄ mə·qō·w·mōw wə·lō- ‘ō·wḏ tə·šū·ren·nū
verses.literal: The eye [that] saw him will see him no more and his place will no longer behold him

verses.original: בָּ֭נָיו יְרַצּ֣וּ דַלִּ֑ים וְ֝יָדָ֗יו תָּשֵׁ֥בְנָה אוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·nāw yə·raṣ·ṣū ḏal·lîm wə·yā·ḏāw tā·šê·ḇə·nāh ’ō·w·nōw
verses.literal: His sons will seek the favor of the poor for his own hands must return his wealth

verses.original: עֲלוּמוֹ מָלְא֣וּ עַ֭צְמוֹתָיו תִּשְׁכָּֽב׃ וְ֝עִמּ֗וֹ עַל־ עָפָ֥ר
verses.transliteration: ʿă·lū·mō mā·lə·’ū ‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯāw tiš·kāḇ wə·‘im·mōw ‘al- ‘ā·p̄ār
verses.literal: The youthful vigor that fills his bones will lie down with him in the dust

verses.original: אִם־ רָעָ֑ה תַּמְתִּ֣יק בְּפִ֣יו יַ֝כְחִידֶ֗נָּה תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- rā·‘āh tam·tîq bə·p̄îw yaḵ·ḥî·ḏen·nāh ta·ḥaṯ lə·šō·w·nōw
verses.literal: Though evil is sweet in his mouth and he conceals it under his tongue

verses.original: יַחְמֹ֣ל עָ֭לֶיהָ וְלֹ֣א יַֽעַזְבֶ֑נָּה וְ֝יִמְנָעֶ֗נָּה בְּת֣וֹךְ חִכּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yaḥ·mōl ‘ā·le·hā wə·lō ya·‘az·ḇen·nāh wə·yim·nā·‘en·nāh bə·ṯō·wḵ ḥik·kōw
verses.literal: though he cannot bear . . . . . . to let it go and keeps it in his mouth

verses.original: בְּמֵעָ֣יו לַ֭חְמוֹ נֶהְפָּ֑ךְ מְרוֹרַ֖ת פְּתָנִ֣ים בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·mê·‘āw laḥ·mōw neh·pāḵ mə·rō·w·raṯ pə·ṯā·nîm bə·qir·bōw
verses.literal: yet in his stomach his food sours into the venom of cobras within him

verses.original: בָּ֭לַע חַ֣יִל וַיְקִאֶ֑נּוּ אֵֽל׃ יוֹרִשֶׁ֥נּוּ מִ֝בִּטְנ֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: bā·la‘ ḥa·yil way·qi·’en·nū ’êl yō·w·ri·šen·nū mib·biṭ·nōw
verses.literal: He swallows wealth but vomits it out God will force it from his stomach

verses.original: יִינָ֑ק רֹאשׁ־ פְּתָנִ֥ים לְשׁ֣וֹן אֶפְעֶֽה׃ תַּֽ֝הַרְגֵ֗הוּ
verses.transliteration: yî·nāq rōš- pə·ṯā·nîm lə·šō·wn ’ep̄·‘eh ta·har·ḡê·hū
verses.literal: He will suck the poison of cobras the fangs of a viper will kill him

verses.original: אַל־ יֵ֥רֶא בִפְלַגּ֑וֹת נַהֲרֵ֥י נַ֝חֲלֵ֗י דְּבַ֣שׁ וְחֶמְאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- yê·re ḇip̄·lag·gō·wṯ na·hă·rê na·ḥă·lê də·ḇaš wə·ḥem·’āh
verses.literal: He will not enjoy the streams the rivers flowing with honey and cream

verses.original: מֵשִׁ֣יב יָ֭גָע וְלֹ֣א יִבְלָ֑ע וְלֹ֣א יַעֲלֹֽס׃ כְּחֵ֥יל תְּ֝מוּרָת֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: mê·šîḇ yā·ḡā‘ wə·lō yiḇ·lā‘ wə·lō ya·‘ă·lōs kə·ḥêl tə·mū·rā·ṯōw
verses.literal: He must return the fruit of his labor without consuming it he cannot enjoy the profits of his trading

verses.original: כִּֽי־ רִ֭צַּץ עָזַ֣ב דַּלִּ֑ים גָּ֝זַ֗ל בַּ֥יִת וְלֹ֣א יִבֶנֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- riṣ·ṣaṣ ‘ā·zaḇ dal·lîm gā·zal ba·yiṯ wə·lō yi·ḇe·nê·hū
verses.literal: For he has oppressed [and] forsaken the poor he has seized houses he did not build

verses.original: כִּ֤י׀ בְּבִטְנ֑וֹ לֹא־ יָדַ֣ע שָׁלֵ֣ו לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט׃ בַּ֝חֲמוּד֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: kî bə·ḇiṭ·nōw lō- yā·ḏa‘ šā·lêw lō yə·mal·lêṭ ba·ḥă·mū·ḏōw
verses.literal: Because his appetite is never satisfied . . . he cannot escape with his treasure

verses.original: אֵין־ שָׂרִ֥יד לְאָכְל֑וֹ עַל־ כֵּ֝֗ן טוּבֽוֹ׃ לֹא־ יָחִ֥יל
verses.transliteration: ’ên- śā·rîḏ lə·’ā·ḵə·lōw ‘al- kên ṭū·ḇōw lō- yā·ḥîl
verses.literal: Nothing is left for him to consume thus . . . his prosperity will not endure

verses.original: בִּמְלֹ֣אות שִׂ֭פְקוֹ יֵ֣צֶר ל֑וֹ כָּל־ יַ֖ד עָמֵ֣ל תְּבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bim·lō·wṯ śip̲·qô yê·ṣer lōw kāl- yaḏ ‘ā·mêl tə·ḇō·w·’en·nū
verses.literal: In the midst of his plenty he will be distressed the full force of misery will come upon him

verses.original: יְהִ֤י׀ לְמַלֵּ֬א בִטְנ֗וֹ יְֽשַׁלַּח־ חֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑וֹ בּ֭וֹ וְיַמְטֵ֥ר עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ בִּלְחוּמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hî lə·mal·lê ḇiṭ·nōw yə·šal·laḥ- ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pōw bōw wə·yam·ṭêr ‘ā·lê·mōw bil·ḥū·mōw
verses.literal: When he has filled his stomach God will vent His fury . . . upon him raining it down on him as he eats

verses.original: יִ֭בְרַח בַּרְזֶ֑ל מִנֵּ֣שֶׁק נְחוּשָֽׁה׃ קֶ֣שֶׁת תַּ֝חְלְפֵ֗הוּ
verses.transliteration: yiḇ·raḥ bar·zel min·nê·šeq nə·ḥū·šāh qe·šeṯ taḥ·lə·p̄ê·hū
verses.literal: Though he flees from an iron weapon a bronze-tipped arrow will pierce him

verses.original: שָׁלַף֮ וַיֵּצֵ֪א מִגֵּ֫וָ֥ה וּ֭בָרָק מִֽמְּרֹרָת֥וֹ אֵמִֽים׃ יַהֲלֹ֗ךְ עָלָ֥יו
verses.transliteration: šā·lap̄ way·yê·ṣê mig·gê·wāh ū·ḇā·rāq mim·mə·rō·rā·ṯōw ’ê·mîm ya·hă·lōḵ ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: It is drawn out of his back the gleaming point from his liver Terrors come over him

verses.original: כָּל־ חֹשֶׁךְ֮ טָמ֪וּן לִצְפּ֫וּנָ֥יו אֵ֣שׁ לֹֽא־ נֻפָּ֑ח יֵ֖רַע תְּ֭אָכְלֵהוּ שָׂרִ֣יד בְּאָהֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ḥō·šeḵ ṭā·mūn liṣ·pū·nāw ’êš lō- nup·pāḥ yê·ra‘ tə·’ā·ḵə·lê·hū śā·rîḏ bə·’ā·ho·lōw
verses.literal: Total darkness is reserved for his treasures A fire unfanned . . . . . . will consume him and devour what is left in his tent

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣יִם יְגַלּ֣וּ עֲוֺנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֶ֗רֶץ מִתְקוֹמָ֘מָ֥ה לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma·yim yə·ḡal·lū ‘ă·wō·nōw wə·’e·reṣ miṯ·qō·w·mā·māh lōw
verses.literal: The heavens will expose his iniquity and the earth will rise up against him

verses.original: יְב֣וּל בֵּית֑וֹ יִ֭גֶל נִ֝גָּר֗וֹת בְּי֣וֹם אַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ḇūl bê·ṯōw yi·ḡel nig·gā·rō·wṯ bə·yō·wm ’ap·pōw
verses.literal: The possessions of his house will be removed flowing away on the day of God’s wrath

verses.original: זֶ֤ה׀ רָ֭שָׁע אָדָ֣ם חֵֽלֶק־ מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְנַחֲלַ֖ת מֵאֵֽל׃פ אִמְר֣וֹ
verses.transliteration: zeh rā·šā‘ ’ā·ḏām ḥê·leq- mê·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·na·ḥă·laṯ mê·’êl ’im·rōw
verses.literal: This is the wicked man’s portion from God the inheritance God has appointed him
